verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Google Cloud shipping MCP servers (Cloud Run MCP, MCP Toolbox for Databases) that let external AI agents/clients (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, etc.) call Google Cloud's tools — this is Google Cloud acting as an MCP server, not as an MCP client consuming external MCP servers' tools. Given Google Cloud's agentic offerings (Vertex AI) this axis is plausible, but there is no evidence of Google Cloud itself connecting to and using third-party MCP servers' tools.
